reason: Episode built a Better Stack status page with custom domain; SSL stuck for 40+ minutes and no reusable checklist existed for verifying CNAME/CAA/TLS or avoiding an overstated cause. Durable setup procedure for future status pages.
Local TLS failure was misattributed for a while; staging vantage proved the cert and status page were fine. Skill should force the second-vantage check before any cause is stated.
Heartbeat coverage limits and expected deploy-time 502 incidents were learned during setup and should be stated up front so future reports are accurate.
